title: Acchi Kocchi: PLACE=PRINCESS
justification: AniList 16273 (OVA, 1 episode(s) from 2012-11-07) is AniDB 8890's special(s) S1, aired 2012-11-16. AniList's PREQUEL relation names AniList 12291, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 8890, the special's title matches the AniList native title, and AniDB lists MAL 16273 on AniDB 8890. TVDB 257888 0x1 'Place = Princess' aired the same day.
